name: Official mathematics-program component crosswalk
purpose: Connect grade/subject index rows for mathematics course components to the official parent mathematics FRP when the course is integrated or explicitly named within that FRP.
policy: This crosswalk resolves a source-index mapping gap only. It never marks a row VERIFIED_COMPLETE and never proves that every required textbook, lesson, assignment or exercise is present.
For grades 1-6, Algebra/Geometry and Probability & Statistics (grades 5-6) point to the parent mathematics programme only; they must not be represented as separate courses based on this mapping.
For grades 7-11, the relevant FRPs explicitly structure mathematics through the named courses Algebra, Geometry and Probability & Statistics.
Do not use this crosswalk to classify textbook bibliographic records, OCR records, extracurricular programmes, or authored exercises as matching those sub-courses.

All five programme PDFs are official EDSOO links represented in the federal working-programme catalogue; the repository labels them as source-linked corpus, not as re-verified against every 2026 amendment.

evidence.reviewedSummary: The official 5-9 mathematics FRP describes Mathematics as the course for grades 5-6, then Algebra and Geometry in grades 7-9, with Probability & Statistics in the mathematics programme. The official 10-11 FRP names Algebra and beginnings of mathematical analysis, Geometry, and Probability & Statistics.
